author: benjaminion
content: Apparently I'm a mod now, so I guess I get to have a rare disagreement with Adrian. This seems as good a place as any for links to PQ opinion pieces (which seem to be the current way people like to exchange views - see acd channel). Twitter/X is an unreliable medium for discovering stuff, and I miss things there. Open to suggestions on where else would be good. I guess we could have a dedicated pq-blog channel, but this one is not so busy and occasional links + threads seem ok to me.

author: potuz
content: +1, it's hard to strike a balance on what's right and wrong here, but definitely we should remove the Danny-era guideline that this server is not for governance discussions since this server is definitely the best possible venue for such discussions.
